utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw the flyer, but I might’ve missed the details. What do we need to fix?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mostly small household stuff — lamps, chairs, bikes, that sort of thing. I can check the flyer and tell you the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d help — I’m easy to miss the details. Just let me know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Honestly, if you can bring a drill and a few basic tools, that’d be huge. I’m still sorting the rest, so I’ll let you know what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring a drill and some basic tools. Just point me to the first thing that needs fixing when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — we still need a hand with the porch rail, a leaky faucet, and sorting tools at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the porch rail and help sort tools at the shed. If you want, I can stop by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. If you know what they need most, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a bit behind on the details too, but I can check and get back to you. If you hear what they need most, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you decided what you’re fixing first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m thinking I’ll start with the loose fence gate and maybe that squeaky step if I can find my tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds sensible—do you want me to help you check the gate first, or are you starting with the step?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can chip in a little, but I need to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — how much can you quietly put in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can manage twenty dollars this week, maybe a little more next week if things settle down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’d appreciate the update if you hear anything. I’m still catching bits and pieces, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep asking around and let you know as soon as I hear the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over whatever supplies we’ve got on hand for the repair drive. Just tell me what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a little late, but I can swing by and help sort what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries at all — swing by when you can, and we’ll sort through it together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Noah—what’s the next thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, thanks, Mara. I think we still need someone to help sort the donated tools and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can do that—just tell me when and where to sort and label the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and spare parts—pretty nice turnout so far.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, that’s good to hear. I’m glad people are showing up for it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Definitely—if the weather holds, I bet we’ll get a few more neighbors by later this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the logistics—what time are we loading up, and do we have enough space for everything?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re loading up around 9, and I think we’ve got enough space if we pack it tight. I’ll double-check the truck and confirm with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good—can you send me the final headcount and a quick list of what still needs to go in?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the repair drive spots for us—just point me to the first address.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s start at 14 Maple Street, and I’ll send the next few stops right after.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’m marking 14 Maple Street as our first stop. Send the next addresses whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful — could you bring a drill, some screws, and maybe a pair of work gloves? If you’ve got a little time, you can also help sort the supplies when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring the drill, screws, and work gloves, and I can help sort the supplies when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring my tools, but I’m a bit all over the place today. Tell me what still needs fixing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that helps. I’ve got a small list, but I want to make sure we don’t miss anything or double up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Good call — let’s go through it together so I can grab the right tools and not get in the way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple—tell me what needs fixing and when you’d like me there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’d love your help. The main things are a loose fence gate and a couple of wobbly benches, and if you could come by Saturday morning, that would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works for me. I’ll bring my basic tools and we can start with the fence gate first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please send them over. I’d like to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details right over so you can take a look!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive if you want — who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe start with the folks on Oak and the apartment manager—can you confirm you’ll contact them?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the folks on Oak and the apartment manager first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. I’ve got a simple plan: we’re collecting the items today, and then I’ll sort them by afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can help gather the items now. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, it’s happening. I’ll bring my tools and be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure—see you there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the repair drive work if we keep it around the school pickup window. Just tell me the time and I’ll coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds good—school pickup usually wraps up around 3:15. I can bring the tools by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 3:15 works for me. I’ll be there right after pickup and we can get it started.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I really appreciate it. I’ll let you know as soon as I have an update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll check back in later if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details first? I want to make sure I have the right date and what needs fixing before I help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have the details on me right now, but I can check and tell you the date and what they’re collecting.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that would help—please send me the date and what they’re collecting when you can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’d really appreciate that. I’ll let you know what needs doing and when we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No problem — just send me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus. I’ll check the list and let you know exactly what tools are needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep my toolbox ready. Just send me the list when you’ve got it.
